fusions.name: Limping Lure
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A snapping bite that deals 9 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your own health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Shallows Ambush
fusions.desc: Lunges out through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sham Tears
fusions.desc: Feigned distress pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Weakest at the Bank
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. You gain 4% dodge chance.
